Authentic learning in an AI world

Guide responsible AI use, identify AI-generated writing, and assess securely with solutions purpose-built for education.
Chat with an expert

AI designed for learning with Turnitin Clarity

Shift the focus from AI as a hurdle to AI as a tool for student growth.
Discover Clarity

Understand your secondary student's writing process

No more guesswork. No more blind spots. See the work behind the words with robust analytics and AI insights.

Tell me more

NEW DATA!

Transparency reduces outsourcing work to AI

Protect critical thinking and keep students engaged in their own writing

Read the report

Take your place with more than 16,000 institutions worldwide who partner with Turnitin

Whatever your goal, there’s an integrity tool to match

The rise of AI has left many educators out at sea. Find your life-raft from our suite of integrity products.

Explore solutions

Learning integrity

Verify originality in seconds. Check for AI writing, compare student work against the world’s largest academic database, and promote responsible AI use directly in your LMS.

Learn more

Secure assessments

Stop cheating in its tracks when you lock down devices to block the internet, integrated AI tools, and notes. Verify student ID and deliver secure digital exams - even offline.

Learn more

Research integrity

Scan documents, grant proposals, theses, and dissertations for text similarity and AI writing so you can publish with confidence.

Learn more

For educators. For students. For integrity.  Explore Turnitin’s purpose-built education solutions.

View all customer stories
